firstLines.title: peer-execution disabled-grant cleanup is dead on ESM: named import of ssh2 utils throws at runtime
firstLines.description: Current server-stderr on agent bob (v1.3.953) logs at every boot: [peer-execution] disabled-grant cleanup blocked: Named export utils not found. The requested module ssh2 is a CommonJS module, which may not support all module.exports as named exports. The runtime prints its own fix in the very next lines: import pkg from ssh2; const { utils } = pkg. So the disabled-grant cleanup path never runs — grants that should be reaped on cleanup are silently retained. Fix is a one-line import change from a named import to a default import with destructuring at the ssh2 callsite in the peer-execution mod

and core/devAgentGate.js:35:

  return explicitEnabled ?? !!config?.developmentAgent;

So there are TWO routes to a stamp: an explicit multiMachi
